sources.title: GitHub - youssofal/MTPLX: 3x faster speeds on MLX | Qwen 3.8 27B ...
sources.snippet: MTPLX is a native Mac app and a command line for running local language models with multi-token prediction. Modern models like Qwen 3.5/3.6 ship with built-in MTP heads. Almost no runtime uses them. MTPLX does: the model drafts several tokens ahead of itself, verifies them in one batched forward pass, and keeps only what passes exact rejection sampling. Same model, same output distribution ...
